status: Frozen before new numerical experiments; archived inputs already inspected.
convention: Compare free coefficients n=2..N. c_opt=-archived c; residual 1+sum c*r. D(s)=sum c_n*(n**(-s)-1/n), so D(1)=0; induced coefficient at n=1 excluded from coefficient statistics. Verify sign by J1/J2 before interpreting.
profiles: Pearson correlation of raw delta linearly interpolated onto 4096 equally spaced u=n/N points on common support [max(2/N1,2/N2),1]; no smoothing or arithmetic demodulation.
regression: OLS with intercept and six requested features; omega counts distinct prime factors; disjoint energy classes primes, proper prime powers exponent>=2, other.
zeros: mpmath 20 dps; all positive critical-line zeros <=1000, plus next neighbor. First cell left boundary 0 and first local min gap uses only next gap; internal cell midpoint boundaries; final cell clipped at1000. Report boundary conventions.
quadrature: Nested Simpson grids per half-cell, initially 16 and32 subdivisions per half-cell; additional refinement if material discrepancy. Also split near t=0 to resolve weight. Direct mpmath zeta at every grid point; complex128 polynomial evaluation. Record actual convergence; not a rigorous interval quadrature.
J3: R7 exact Parseval identity; report truncated head and independently justified explicit tail upper bound. A broad enclosure is only consistency, not high-precision numerical equality. Never use discrete-minus-head as an independent tail bound.
null: 1000 permutations using numpy default_rng seed20261106. Two-sided p=(1+count(abs(r_perm)>=abs(r_obs)))/1001; central95% null band. Same permutation label map for each variable; report all N.

Q3.rule: primary N5000 delta energy fraction n>sqrtN >0.5; report each N

Q4.rule: primary N5000 nonsquarefree optimal free coefficient energy fraction>=0.1; report each N

Q5.rule: N5000 Spearman W vs inverse derivative squared>=0.3 and two-sided permutation p<0.01

Q6.rule: N5000 Spearman W vs RAW minimum gap has same nonzero sign as observed Q5 correlation and two-sided p<0.01. This follows Part B literal raw-gap variable. Inverse-gap correlation is separately labelled secondary; no sign flipping after observing.

scoring: HIT/MISS and mean Brier score; no causal or RH claim.
